preconditions.description: The number of rows in the board must be between 1 and 100.
The number of columns in the board must be between 1 and 100.
The length of the word must be between 1 and the total number of cells in the board.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '1' if isWordExist(board, word) else stdout == '0'
postconditions.description: The output must be '1' if the word exists in the board, otherwise '0'.
